data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental may 2036? You’re in for a treat: warm sunshine, calm Mediterranean seas, and a fleet of luxury boats ready to depart from Puerto Banús. May is one of the best months to charter a boat on the Costa del Sol, with average highs of 25°C, gentle breezes, and water temperatures perfect for a dip. Whether you’re after a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day exploration to Sotogrande, this guide covers everything you need to know — from weather patterns to boat recommendations and booking tips.

May 2036 Weather & Sea Conditions

May 2036 promises classic spring weather: daytime temperatures between 22°C and 28°C, cooling to 16-18°C after sunset. Sea surface temperatures hover around 18-20°C — refreshing but comfortable for swimming. Winds are typically light, often below 10 knots by midday, creating swells under 0.5m. Expect 10-12 hours of sunshine daily, with only 2-3 rainy days on average. These conditions make May ideal for both high-speed cruising on a Pershing 46 and relaxed anchoring off Cabopino.

Top Boats for May Charters

Our Puerto Banús fleet offers options for every group size and budget. For a quick escape, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) seats 9 guests — perfect for a sunset toast. The Azimut 39 (€749/2h) fits 11 and is a favourite for family outings. If you want space and luxury, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski and accommodates 12. For large celebrations, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m) offer deck space and comfort. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Best May Routes from Puerto Banús

May’s calm seas open up multiple routes. Westbound: head to Estepona (12 NM, 45 min) for its charming old town and beachfront chiringuitos, or continue to Sotogrande (20 NM, 1.5h) for exclusive marina dining. Eastbound: Cala del Faro (8 NM) offers a quiet cove with clear water, while Cabopino (10 NM) has a lively beach club. For a shorter trip, cruise the Golden Mile coastline with views of La Concha mountain — ideal for a 2-hour charter on the Azimut 39.

What’s Included in Your May Charter

Every booking includes a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, insurance, and safety gear. Onboard, you’ll find water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Spanish IVA (21%) is included in the price — no surprises. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), rates start at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) require a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Booking Tips for May 2036

May weekends fill quickly, especially for the popular Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge. We recommend booking 2-3 weeks in advance to secure your preferred slot. For best availability, consider a weekday charter — Tuesday to Thursday are quieter and often have more boat choices. If your group is flexible, ask about last-minute cancellations. All bookings are confirmed via WhatsApp, with a deposit required. Check our main page for the full fleet and instant pricing.
